about: The claims ledger of Hydralysis (Z13a). One row per claim: id, text (the wording that is true today), class, evidence, the package whose test flips it, and where the wording stands in this repository. tests/test_claims.py fails when a number differs from its source, when a document no longer carries its wording, when a gated claim has no passing test, and when a document uses a wording the rule does not allow. Nothing here gets stronger without its test.

classes.supported: true today as written; the evidence path shows it
classes.true_today: stated only in the qualified wording of the text field; the strong form waits for the package in flips
classes.gated: stated strongly, allowed only because the named test passes
classes.future: not stated anywhere yet; the package in flips makes it true

numbers.note: the X0 oracle baselines do not exist yet; no document may quote one until this row carries a value and a source
